LanguageData.RimLogic.Gizmo.TypeDesc: Choose what this block does, such as AND or a light sensor. Changing the type resets the block setup — sides, links, and outputs.
LanguageData.RimLogic.Gizmo.RenameDesc: Give this block a custom name. It appears in the title and in nearby blocks' link lists, so complex circuits are easier to read.
LanguageData.RimLogic.Gizmo.LinkDesc: Create a signal wire between blocks. Press the button, click this block's output, then click the target block's input. Click empty cells to add route points. Right-click steps back, Esc cancels.
LanguageData.RimLogic.Link.PickOutput: Click the output this link should start from
LanguageData.RimLogic.Link.PickTarget: Click the target block.\nLeft-click an empty cell to add a route point; right-click to remove the last.
LanguageData.RimLogic.Link.DeleteHint: Hover over a link and click to delete it
LanguageData.RimLogic.Gizmo.IconColorDesc: Change the icon color on this block, so similar blocks are easier to tell apart.
LanguageData.RimLogic.Gizmo.ElectroIODesc: Configure the electrical sides: which side takes power (input), and which side sends it out (output). Any side can be disabled.
LanguageData.RimLogic.Gizmo.LogicIODesc: Configure the logic sides: which side receives a signal (input), and which side sends one out (output). A disabled side shows no indicator.
LanguageData.RimLogic.Gizmo.ReconnectDesc: Choose which nearby power conduit feeds this block. Press the button, then click the conduit you want.
LanguageData.RimLogic.Feed.NoNet: There is no reachable power conduit nearby.
LanguageData.RimLogic.Settings.None: This block has nothing to configure yet.
LanguageData.RimLogic.Sensor.Title: Power sensor settings
LanguageData.RimLogic.Sensor.Desc: Outputs a signal when the selected power-grid value matches the condition.
LanguageData.RimLogic.Sensor.NetDesc: How much surplus power the grid is producing right now
LanguageData.RimLogic.Sensor.BatDesc: Total charge stored in all batteries
LanguageData.RimLogic.LightSensor.Title: Light sensor settings
LanguageData.RimLogic.LightSensor.Desc: Outputs a signal and passes power from input to output when the light level under the block matches the condition.
LanguageData.RimLogic.TempSensor.Title: Temperature sensor settings
LanguageData.RimLogic.TempSensor.Desc: Outputs a signal and passes power from input to output when the temperature under the block matches the condition.
LanguageData.RimLogic.PollSensor.Title: Pollution sensor settings
LanguageData.RimLogic.PollSensor.Desc: Outputs a signal and passes power from input to output when there is pollution in the selected area.
LanguageData.RimLogic.PollSensor.RoomNote: Checks the room where the block is placed. Outdoors, it checks a small area around the block instead.
LanguageData.RimLogic.FireSensor.Title: Fire sensor settings
LanguageData.RimLogic.FireSensor.Desc: Outputs a signal and passes power from input to output while something is burning in the selected area.
LanguageData.RimLogic.Clock.Title: Clock settings
LanguageData.RimLogic.Clock.Desc: Outputs a signal at the chosen time of day.
LanguageData.RimLogic.Loudspeaker.Title: Loudspeaker settings
LanguageData.RimLogic.Loudspeaker.Desc: When it receives a signal, it shows a notification with your own text.
LanguageData.RimLogic.MotionSensor.Title: Motion sensor settings
LanguageData.RimLogic.MotionSensor.Desc: Outputs a signal and passes power from input to output when a selected kind of target is inside the area.
LanguageData.RimLogic.Timer.Title: Timer settings
LanguageData.RimLogic.Timer.Desc: Repeats the input signal on the output after a delay. Set the delay with the slider.
LanguageData.RimLogic.Memory.Title: Memory settings
LanguageData.RimLogic.Memory.Desc: Stores a number from the input and keeps it. Whenever the value changes, it sends a pulse.
LanguageData.RimLogic.Math.Title: Math block settings
LanguageData.RimLogic.Math.Desc: Choose an operation. The first number comes from the left input; the second comes from the right.
LanguageData.RimLogic.MathOp.Absolute: Absolute value — the number without its minus sign (uses one number)
LanguageData.RimLogic.MathOp.GreaterEqual: Greater or equal: 1 if first ≥ second
LanguageData.RimLogic.MathOp.LessEqual: Less or equal: 1 if first ≤ second
LanguageData.RimLogic.MathOp.ApproxEqual: Approximately equal: 1 if the difference is no more than 1
LanguageData.RimLogic.Multitool.Title: Multitool settings
LanguageData.RimLogic.Multitool.Desc: Choose an operating mode and its settings.
LanguageData.RimLogic.Multitool.Mode.CountItems: Count items: counts the selected item in the area, both on the ground and in storage
LanguageData.RimLogic.Multitool.Mode.ToggleDevice: Toggle device: turns a nearby device on or off by signal
LanguageData.RimLogic.Multitool.Mode.OpenCloseDoor: Control doors: opens or closes doors in the area by signal
LanguageData.RimLogic.Multitool.Mode.CropMaturity: Crop maturity: counts harvest-ready plants in the area
LanguageData.RimLogic.Multitool.NoDevices: There are no nearby devices that can be toggled.
LanguageData.RimLogic.Multitool.WorkMode: How to react to the signal
LanguageData.RimLogic.Multitool.Mode.PawnDetector: Count pawns: counts pawns in the area by filter (groups or one specific pawn)
LanguageData.RimLogic.Multitool.Mode.StorageFullness: Storage fullness: checks how full the storage in the area is, in percent
LanguageData.RimLogic.Multitool.StorageAllNote: All storage in the operating area is counted.
LanguageData.RimLogic.ElectroIO.Title: Electrical sides
LanguageData.RimLogic.ElectroIO.Desc: Assign each side a role: take power (input), send power out (output), or do nothing.
LanguageData.RimLogic.ElectroIO.Hint: Up to {0} inputs and {1} outputs. Left-click sets an input, right-click sets an output, and clicking the same side again disables it.
LanguageData.RimLogic.LogicIO.Title: Logic sides
LanguageData.RimLogic.LogicIO.Desc: Assign each side a role: receive a signal (input), send a signal (output), or do nothing.
LanguageData.RimLogic.LogicIO.Hint: Up to {0} inputs and {1} outputs. Left-click sets an input, right-click sets an output, and clicking the same side again disables it. Only assigned sides show indicators.
LanguageData.RimLogic.TypeWindow.Title: Block type
LanguageData.RimLogic.TypeWindow.Desc: Choose what this block should be, then press Done.
LanguageData.RimLogic.ColorWindow.Title: Icon color
